sloka: स एष सह सैन्येन प्राप्तः किल निकुम्भिलाम्।यद्युत्तिष्ठेत् कृतं कर्म हतान् सर्वांश्च विद्धि नः ।। ६.८५.१४ ।।
transliteration: sa eṣa saha sainyena prāptaḥ kila nikumbhilām।yadyuttiṣṭhet kṛtaṁ karma hatān sarvāṁśca viddhi naḥ ।। 6.85.14 ।।

translations.english: "O mighty armed Rama! that enemy of yours, while you have not reached Nikumbhilam and not propitiated fire sacrifice, can cause your death. Such a boon was granted to him, the enemy of Indra by the Lord of all worlds."
translations.hindi: द्रजीत का अग्नि के समान चमचमाता सुवण का शाङ्ख था ओर ध्वजा वैदूय मणि से भलीमांति अलड कृत थी
